components.selection_rule: After Phase 2 activation, and only after the canonical row-level file and license are supplied, prefer positions with repeated expert evidence, useful within-position quality spread, and source/style balance; create additional critiques where a selected position has fewer than four eligible critiques.
promotion_gates: position, critique, rating, and revision semantics audited
exact 50 position IDs frozen in a controlled manifest

components.selection_rule: After Phase 2 activation, select exactly 20 positions only after the LMCA and protected-source inventories are available. Fill domain, attack-family, length, and source/style deficits first, then prefer positions that discriminate among frozen acquisition judges. Existing synthetic critiques remain unrated candidates until expert review.
promotion_gates: all 80 critiques receive new human-review provenance

components.selection_rule: After Phase 2 activation, nominate the 30 upstream position records without publishing transformed item text, item IDs, critiques, or labels. Each position must pass independent source-fidelity and ambiguity/scope review before critique production. The human/model authorship mix for the four critiques requires a separate approved decision.
promotion_gates: rights and jurisdiction review for cited editions
four versioned critiques produced per approved position
protected item and exposure manifests frozen

required_before_activation: The 48-critique pilot completion requirements pass and its pre-registered scale-readiness findings are reviewed.
Senior methodological feedback is recorded and material concerns are resolved or disclosed.
External funding is secured or documented qualified-volunteer commitments cover the complete 400-critique workload, expected re-ratings, adjudication, replacements, and operations.
The project owner explicitly approves Phase 2 activation in a new decision record.

invariants: Each component critique count equals positions multiplied by four.
The public synthetic component cannot be represented as expert rated until new human-review provenance exists.
Protected item IDs, text, critiques, and labels are absent from public manifests.
Position is the split unit; sibling critiques never cross splits.
The allocation is a deferred Phase 2 strategy and creates no current acquisition, rating, payment, deadline, or recruitment commitment.
Pilot completion does not automatically activate Phase 2.
unresolved_parameters: Exact 50 LMCA position IDs and any additional critique acquisition plan.
Exact 20 public-synthetic position IDs, pending cross-source balance and difficulty screening.
Authorship mix and production method for 120 protected critiques.
External funding or documented complete qualified-volunteer capacity for the 400-critique workload.
Phase 2 panel, assignment, numerical adjudication, quality-control, and capacity policies informed by the pilot.
